facts.statement: Palaeocursornis is classified as a dubious genus of avemetatarsalian, likely an azhdarchoid pterosaur.
facts.quote: Palaeocursornis is a dubious genus of avemetatarsalian, probably an azhdarchoid pterosaur.

facts.statement: The fossil was found in Early Cretaceous Berriasian rocks dating to around 143 million years ago from a mine at Cornet near Oradea in northwestern Romania.
facts.quote: found in Early Cretaceous (Berriasian rocks (dating to around 143 mya) from a mine at Cornet near Oradea in northwestern Romania.

facts.statement: In 2025, Thomas and McDavid suggested that Palaeocursornis is a dubious genus of tapejaroid.
facts.quote: In 2025, Thomas and McDavid suggested that Palaeocursornis is a dubious genus of tapejaroid.

facts.statement: The animal lived on an archipelago of volcanic and coral islands located towards the east of the Piemont-Liguria Ocean.
facts.quote: The animal occurred on what at that time was an archipelago of volcanic and coral islands towards the east of the Piemont-Liguria Ocean.

facts.statement: Palaeocursornis is classified within the family Azhdarchidae.
Palaeocursornis belongs to the suborder Pterodactyloidea.
Palaeocursornis is part of the superfamily Azhdarchoidea.
The genus Palaeocursornis was established by Kessler & Jurcsák in 1986.
The type species was originally described as Limnornis corneti by Kessler & Jurcsák in 1984.
It was initially considered a flightless paleognath bird, possibly a ratite, and later as an ornithuromorph bird or non-avian theropod.
facts.quote: Se consideró inicialmente que era un ave paleognata no voladora, posiblemente un ratites, y más tarde como un ave ornituromorfa o un terópodo no aviano (Benton et al., 1997).

facts.statement: However, a re-evaluation suggested the specimen was not a femur but the humerus of a pterodactyloid pterosaur similar to Azhdarcho.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, una revaluación del espécimen sugirió que este no era un fémur, sino el húmero de un pterosaurio pterodactiloide similar a Azhdarcho.

facts.statement: The bones were initially described as Limnornis corneti, but this genus name had already been used for the curve-billed reedhaunter (L. curvirostris), an ovenbird.
facts.quote: Inicialmente, los huesos fueron descritos como Limnornis corneti (Kessler & Jurcsák, 1984). Sin embargo, este nombre de género ya había sido usado para la pajera de pico curvo (L. curvirostris), una furnárida.

facts.statement: Furthermore, the bones attributed to the new taxon appeared to belong to two different species that were possibly not even closely related.
facts.quote: Más áun, los huesos adscritos al nuevo taxón parecían pertenecer a dos especies diferentes, que posiblemente no estaban siquiera relacionadas de cerca.

facts.statement: The currently valid name Palaeocursornis corneti was first mentioned by Jurcsák & Kessler in 1985 but was a nomen nudum until it became valid the following year when the genus was officially established.
facts.quote: El nombre válido actualmente, Palaeocursornis corneti, fue mencionado originalmente por Jurcsák & Kessler en 1985, pero era un nomen nudum por esa época y solo se volvió válido el año siguiente, cuando el nuevo género fue establecido de forma oficial
